crossRefs.note: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;
He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements;

translations.web: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
translations.bsb: Next he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
translations.kjv: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
translations.asv: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
